title: Hanging Metal Chimes
description: A cluster of metallic cylindrical wind chimes and bells hangs from ropes and hooks against a dark abstract background. Several chimes have broken free and are falling or scattered below with swirling ribbons and debris.
prompt: A dramatic oil painting of a tangled cluster of metallic wind chimes and cylindrical bells suspended from ropes and hooks in darkness. Some chimes have broken loose and are falling with swirling ribbons and fragments below, rendered with expressive brushstrokes and strong highlights on the reflective metal surfaces against a deep black abstract background.
